sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Prateek Kumar
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to respondent no.2 to decide the representation of the petitioner dated 13.09.2023 in the light of the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013;
direct respondent no.2 to take necessary action as per the provisions of the said Act for having utilized the land of the petitioner for public purposes and to award compensation; to pass additional award in favour of the petitioner for rehabilitation and resettlement.
2. Learned Standing Counsel, in pursuance of our previous order, obtained instructions from the Collector, according to which, it was not in dispute that the land of the petitioner had been utilized.
Smt. Kamla vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90771362/
1

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Kamla vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The State-respondents took the stand that they would initiate proceedings for acquisition of the land of the petitioner and would pay compensation to her.

3. On matter being taken up today, fresh instructions have been submitted by the State-respondents wherein it is indicated that since the petitioner had refused to transfer title in favour of the respondents by executing sale deed and, therefore, the respondents have started proceedings for compulsory acquisition under the provisions of the Act.
Notification under Section 11 of the Act had been published on 14.06.2024 and sixty days' time has been granted to file objections

, thereafter,
further action would be taken and compensation would be paid.

4. Having regard to the aforesaid stand of the respondents, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that the respondents shall conclude the proceedings relating to acquisition expeditiously so that the petitioner is duly compensated.
5. The order has been passed in the presence of Shri Prateek Kumar, learned counsel for respondent no.3.
(Manish Kumar Nigam, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 8.8.2024
